title: 4.6 / 5.4 2-valve modular: spark plug blown out of the head
summary: Early aluminum heads have few threads holding the plug; a plug can eject and take the threads with it.
body: Symptom: sudden loud ticking/puffing, misfire, coil-on-plug pushed up or broken. Repair is a thread insert (purpose-built kits for these heads can be installed with the head on the engine), not a new head. Torque plugs to spec on every plug job: under-torqued plugs are the usual cause.
